itemList.description: Operation and mainteanance of light sources mentioned below as and the cost of men and material as directed by the engineer in charge, here the work include supply and replacement of all component materials such lamp/choke/starters/ignitor/condensor/side holders/wires etc.compllete for the street lighting as per the specification mentioned below including painting of poles and footings pole numbering and preparing for master register for each ward/division ,removing of buntings ,postres ,threads, banners,from the street lighting poles.direct tapping bi metal and all other nature of faults etc. to be attended by the contractor at his cost only. 40 watt Fluorescent tube light fixture for street light

HPSV Lamp fixturea should be of single piece gravity die cast LM6 Alloy.ISI Marked street light luminaries suitable for 250w eliptical high pressure sodium vapour made by gravity die cast aluminium Housing.Hgigh transerant Acrylic bowl firmly held with the canopy by means of stainless steel toggles and rubber gasket,Opticl control is provides by reflectors.the controlgear housing accommadates low loss heavy duty polyester filled copper wire wound Ballast .Power factor improvement capacitor and ignitor(for HPSV lamp)all pre wired up to the tedminal block.the luminary is painted White inside and hammer tone grey out side ,the luminaries meet IP-65 protection and conform to IS;10322(Part 5/sec.3) specificatins250W

Operation and maintenance of LED source including cost of men and materials as directed by the Engineer in Charge. The work includes supply and replacement of all component materials such as drivers, front protection covers and aluminium housing body for optimal thermal dissipation. Lamp compartment comprising of anti glare clear diffuser with injection moulded polycarbonate material, delivering superior light output. Rated life of 50000 burning hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance. Maximum light intensity should be between 60 degrees to 70 degrees. CCT greater than 5500K. IP66 rated optical and electrical compartment and impact resistance of complete luminaire greater than IK08. Power factor greater than 0.9 with mains. Surge protection minimum 5KV along with over voltage, overload, short circuit and mis wiring protection. Compatible for pole mounting with outer diameter of 40mm to 50mm. Universal voltage driver to operate within a wide voltage range from 100V to 270V, 50/60Hz application. Compliance with IS 10322, IEC 60598, LM 79 and LM 80. Adherence to RoHS. UL approved MCPCB. Top access street light with single screw to ensure ease of maintenance at the site location with minimum tools. LED light fixture with 25W system power consumption. LED efficiency greater than 130 lm/W. Nominal CRI greater than 75. Luminaire manufacturer should have an in house facility accredited by NABL, CPRI or any Government certified agency and Design and Development facility certified by ISO 9001:2008. Housing with supplier wordmark or name shall be engraved or embossed on the die cast housing or body part. Warranty of 2 years against any manufacturing defect while working under standard electrical conditions as mentioned above shall be provided by the LED manufacturer. LED source shall be of Cree, Nichia or Osram make. LED Street Light 25W (Specification as per sanctioned estimate)
